title: Analyze agent usage and find wasted tokens with Unity Gateway Insights (Beta)
body: You can now generate Unity Gateway Insights reports that show what people use agents for and where tokens go to waste. Genie Code builds each report from a sample of sessions in the [unified trace table](/aws/en/ai-gateway/unified-trace-table). Insights is in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). See [Analyze agent usage with Insights](/aws/en/ai-gateway/insights).
